name: OneDrive & SharePoint files
summary: Microsoft's personal and team file storage, wired into Windows, Office and Teams.

factors: Windows quietly makes OneDrive the home of your Desktop and Documents folders
SharePoint libraries carry metadata, permissions and workflows that are not files
Sharing links embedded in years of emails and chats will break
Office co-authoring only works on files stored here

export.summary: Files are ordinary files: sync or copy them out. SharePoint content beyond documents (lists, pages, permissions) has no clean export.

methods.name: Sync client
methods.detail: Set every folder to 'Always keep on this device', wait for the sync to finish, then copy the folder elsewhere. Simple, but it needs enough local disk space.

methods.name: rclone
methods.detail: Copies directly from OneDrive or a SharePoint library to another cloud or server without passing through your laptop. It handles throttling and can resume.

caveats: OneNote notebooks are not plain files and must be exported separately from OneNote
Path-length and character rules differ, so a few file names may need fixing
Version history and sharing permissions do not come along
Turn off folder backup (Known Folder Move) before removing OneDrive, or Windows keeps pointing Documents at an empty folder

paths.verdict: The like-for-like replacement: web access, share links, desktop and mobile sync, plus calendar and contacts if you want them.

import.summary: Copy the files into the Nextcloud sync folder, or use rclone to move them server-to-server over WebDAV. Recreate shares afterwards.

transfers: Access from desktop, web and phone
lost: Office desktop co-authoring (browser co-editing replaces it)

paths.verdict: Choose it for large volumes or huge numbers of files where sync speed matters more than extra apps.

import.summary: Create libraries that mirror your top-level folders, then copy the files in through the sync client or with rclone's Seafile backend.

transfers: Access from desktop, web and phone
lost: The surrounding apps (calendar, tasks) that Nextcloud would give you

paths.verdict: For one person or a household that only needs the same folders on several computers. It is not a cloud drive.

import.summary: Download everything to one computer, share the folder in Syncthing and pair your other devices. There is no upload step because there is no server.

lost: On-demand files: every device holds a full copy unless you exclude folders
Sharing with people outside your own devices
A proper mobile experience on iOS
